tokens.name: deep-ocean
tokens.usage: Source palette: deep ocean, the ink and logo-table colour. In UI use the role tokens (ink, brand, solid); use deep-ocean itself in charts, print and the logo.

tokens.name: ocean
tokens.usage: Source palette: ocean teal. Source of the ok status and the low end of the risk scale. Use ok and ok-bg in UI; large fills only, since it is 4.7:1 with white text.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Source palette: coral, the signature accent and the approver seat in the logo. Graphics, large display type and focus rings. Not for text on light grounds (3.5:1); use accent-ink for coral-toned text and accent for text-bearing fills.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Source palette: brick. Error text and the high end of the risk scale.

tokens.name: seat
tokens.usage: Source palette: slate seat grey. Logo seats and neutral chart series. Never text (2.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Source palette: pale ocean-grey. The light page ground.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and tables. ink, ink-muted and accent-ink meet contrast on it. Dark is Graphite.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels and fields sitting on bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text and figures on bg and surface (10.6:1 on bg in light, 18.3:1 in dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and source lines (5.1:1 on bg in light, 10.1:1 on surface in dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and panel edges. Decorative: 1.5:1 in light and 1.7:1 in dark, so never the only cue for a control; use border-strong for that.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, secondary buttons and anything whose edge carries meaning (3.5:1 on bg in light, 4.0:1 on surface in dark). Added to meet 3:1; the mockup uses border.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and inside cards. Decorative only. Do not use var(--line): that name does not exist.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Active-state marks, links and the card outline of a featured plan. Light is deep ocean, dark is a light ocean blue (9.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: Large brand fields: covers, page headers, section bands, and the light-theme primary button. Put white text on it.

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: Fill for completed steps and the dark-theme primary button. Text on it is on-solid.

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Text-bearing coral fill: the current step, destructive buttons, the dark-theme highlight. Text on it is on-accent. Light is slightly deeper than the logo coral so white text reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (4.5:1 light, 5.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Coral-toned text and icons on bg and surface (5.1:1 on bg in light, 8.8:1 on surface in dark). Off-plan figures and warnings.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button: deep ocean in light, coral in dark, as in the mockup. Text on it is on-primary. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary (11.9:1 light). Dark text on dark coral is 5.2:1; the mockup sets white there, which is 3.5:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus outline with a 2px offset (3.5:1 on white in light, 8.8:1 in dark).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour for on-plan and passed states, on ok-bg (5.4:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). Slightly deeper than ocean so it passes.

tokens.name: on-ok
tokens.usage: Text on a solid ok fill, the Approved pill (6.7:1 light, 11.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text and the low risk step.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour for warnings on warn-bg (4.6:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour for errors and off-plan states on err-bg (5.8:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind err text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text and icon colour for in-review and neutral notices on info-bg (4.6:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind info text.

tokens.name: risk-1
tokens.usage: Risk heat step 1, low (score under 5): card tint and register cell.

tokens.name: risk-1-ink
tokens.usage: Text on risk-1 (5.4:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: risk-2
tokens.usage: Risk heat step 2, moderate (5 to 9).

tokens.name: risk-2-ink
tokens.usage: Text on risk-2 (5.4:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: risk-3
tokens.usage: Risk heat step 3, high (10 to 14).

tokens.name: risk-3-ink
tokens.usage: Text on risk-3 (6.2:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: risk-4
tokens.usage: Risk heat step 4, critical (15 and up): solid coral.

tokens.name: risk-4-ink
tokens.usage: Text on risk-4 (4.5:1 light, 5.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, in order. Meets 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, in order. Under 3:1 on white: use for large areas or with direct labels, never as the only cue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3, in order. Meets 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4, in order. Meets 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5, in order. Meets 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6, in order. Under 3:1 on white: use for large areas or with direct labels, never as the only cue.

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Chart series 7, in order. Under 3:1 on white: use for large areas or with direct labels, never as the only cue.

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Chart series 8, in order. Under 3:1 on dark surfaces: use with direct labels.

tokens.name: chart-9
tokens.usage: Chart series 9, in order. Meets 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-10
tokens.usage: Chart series 10, in order. Meets 3:1 against surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Pack title and marketing hero (the mockup sets this fluid, 2rem to 3.4rem).

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The single large number in a metric tile. Figures are Outfit 600; the tile in the mockup uses 27px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Commentary, descriptions, form text. Weight 500 in the dark theme.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, deltas, source lines and ids. There is no monospace: source lines are small Nunito Sans.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status pills, tags, table headers and field labels. Always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, small card padding, tile grid gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default control padding and the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between metric tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a pack.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margin on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, tags, timeline bars, stepper chips and small buttons. Pair with corner-shape: bevel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, tiles, tables and popups. Pair with corner-shape: bevel (slightly angled, not rounded); browsers without it fall back to a 3px round.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and toggles only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on bg. Pack pages prefer borders to shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The roadmap context popup, menus and dialogs only.
